### 2026-10-11 – Moving from the Schematic Editor to the PCB Editor, next is routing the PCB. Took some time to fix the  'Seeed_Studio_XIAO_Series:XIAO-ESP32-C3-SMD' not found error. Took some debugging, and finally f

**1.5h**

Moving from the Schematic Editor to the PCB Editor, next is routing the PCB. Took some time to fix the  'Seeed_Studio_XIAO_Series:XIAO-ESP32-C3-SMD' not found error. Took some debugging, and finally first issue was solved. (import footprint incorrectly)
But second issue was: U1 has more pins than the footprint has pads. Specifically, the symbol defines pins numbered 15–22, but the footprint XIAO-ESP32-C6-DIP has no pads with those numbers.

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 at 21.00.13](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/82B7Uz5qhKRQVW7orkpv03KAt9NgRrZm/13195341bfb88e76e9563a9a8518eca5b7c2dc66fa39ba6384786ff186c56e7e.jpg)

### 2026-10-11 – Still figuring out the pin mismatch. Renamed and did a bunch of different things to try to see if its the correct saved location.

**2h**

Still figuring out the pin mismatch. Renamed and did a bunch of different things to try to see if its the correct saved location.
Seems to be issue with different parts? double checked.
 the tutorial's symbol is the 22-pin XIAO-ESP32-C3-SMD
but the footprint XIAO-ESP32-C6-DIP only has 14 pads.
Not sure what consequences this would have, but will skip for now.

set to move on to the PCB layout, and create the  board outline on the Edge.Cuts layer, arrange the components, then route (X key, switch between F.Cu/B.Cu) etc
